description: NaLiEr₂F₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.55 Å. Li is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted corner-sharing LiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (1.92 Å) and four longer (2.27 Å) Li-F bond lengths. Er is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Er-F bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.45 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Li and two equivalent Er atoms to form distorted FLi₂Er₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Er₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent FNaLiEr₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four equivalent FNaLiEr₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Li, and two equivalent Er atoms to form distorted FNaLiEr₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Er₂ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent FNaLiEr₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FLi₂Er₂ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent FNaLiEr₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Er atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two equivalent Er atoms.
